title: Growth Models Under Uniform Catastrophes
summary: We consider stochastic growth models for populations organized in colonies and subject to uniform catastrophes. To assess population viability, we analyze scenarios in which individuals adopt dispersion strategies after catastrophic events. For these models, we derive explicit expressions for the survival probability and the mean time to extinction, both with and without spatial constraints.
